This illustration features a long, brown rectangular table angled across the composition. A man with tan skin and dark hair, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt, sits at the far end of the table. His head is bowed, and his arms are folded on the table surface. Several red high-backed chairs with black armrests and legs are positioned around the table. Most are empty and upright, while one in the bottom right corner is tipped onto its side.

The word "TEMPO" appears at the top in large red capital letters. Above it are the phrases "Laporan Khusus Karya Seni Pilihan Tempo H.50" and "Siasat Menutup Korupsi Bupati Sidoarjo H.92". Large white text on the table reads "BABAK-BELUR KABINET JOKOWI". Below this, smaller white text says: "Kabinet Indonesia Maju terbelah setelah Presiden Joko Widodo mendukung Prabowo Subianto-Gibran Rakabuming Raka. Sejumlah menteri berencana mundur sebagai bentuk perlawanan. H.32". At the bottom are a barcode, a QR code, and publication details including "5-11 FEBRUARI 2024" and "RP 50.000".
